title: What Steve Jobs and Eric Schmidt actually said when Google built Android
content: Steve Jobs' direct communication with Eric Schmidt sparked a notable shift in Google’s recruiting strategies. Schmidt acted on Jobs' concerns by dismissing recruiters who breached anti-solicitation rules. Legal battles uncovered that these practices adversely impacted employee salaries and recruitment prospects. A notable lawsuit involving several tech giants ended with a hefty settlement about these recruitment policies, showcasing Jobs' powerful role in the cutthroat Silicon Valley talent war.

title: India to probe flydubai attack: NIA files case under anti-hijacking law & UAPA

In a remarkable display of courage, Machchhar managed to open the cockpit door to facilitate assistance. The flight made an emergency landing in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, where he received treatment.

title: Idaho family sues after irrigation shutoff ruins crops on 1,000-acre farm
content: An Idaho family, whose farm thrives along the Snake River, has initiated legal action against the state regarding an emergency order that ceased their irrigation due to dwindling water levels. This abrupt halt has jeopardized their crops and could threaten their agricultural enterprise. They assert that their property rights were infringed upon without due process or fair compensation, highlighting a larger issue surrounding water rights management in the region.

title: Can police arrest you for protesting? Know your rights and what happens next
content: The constitutional right to protest is fundamental, but it comes with responsibilities, allowing authorities to enforce regulations for the sake of public safety. Police may require permits for gatherings based on specific local laws, and they can issue dispersal orders when public safety is at risk, given legal justification. Detained individuals have the right to contest unlawful arrests and assert their rights through appropriate channels.

title: Nevada man turned roadside junk into desert home now visited as free attraction
content: Thunder Mountain Monument in Nevada features sculptures created from discarded materials by Frank Van Zant. This unique roadside attraction developed from his personal vision to honor Native American history. After a fire in 1983, the site faced preservation challenges until it was recognized as a historic site in 1992. The monument is maintained today with visitor donations and a caretaker's assistance.

title: David Gilmour auctioned guitars for $21.5m, donated proceeds to climate causes
content: In June 2019, David Gilmour sold over 120 guitars, significantly benefitting ClientEarth with the proceeds. Among them was the iconic 1969 Fender Stratocaster, which achieved a record sale price. These funds were dedicated to advancing environmental law initiatives aimed at combatting climate change. This remarkable auction intertwined rock legacy and ecological activism, illustrating Gilmour's commitment to fostering a sustainable future through music.

title: Zerodha’s Dinesh Pai sees an upside in US green card suspension for TCS, Infosys, Wipro
content: The US announced a suspension of eight technology and IT services companies from its green card labour certification programme. This decision affects companies like TCS, Infosys, and Wipro and impacts Indian professionals in the US. While the suspension halts new and pending applications, it does not affect existing visas or green cards. Industry experts suggest that work may shift from the US to India due to this situation.

Previously sold for $6.4 million in 2021, the property is perfect for those seeking tranquility in Southern California, featuring an infinity-edge pool and meticulously landscaped outdoor areas, appealing to buyers looking for space and luxury.

title: Mexican innovator, 21, turns discarded materials into power and cleaner water

By 2027, Sanchez intends to create 50 operational fuel cells, enhancing energy accessibility and promoting water quality.

title: How many trains can one stop? Can't halt youth of India: Union minister Chirag Paswan
content:
NEW DELHI: "They are the youth of India. Nobody can stop them," BJP ally and Union minister Chirag Paswan said Friday, replying to allegations that govt was curbing train and metro services to stop people from attending Saturday's protest called by CJP over the SIR issue. "Some people are trying to spread such misconceptions. How many trains can one stop? How many roads can one block? They are India's youth, capable of showing the way to the world. Generations have done it. No one can stop them," the LJP (Ram Vilas) president told reporters on the sidelines of an event. After CEC Gyanesh Kumar came under scrutiny following the charge that he was taking unilateral decisions, Chirag had called for clarification but quickly backed out after Election Commission released a statement to suggest that decisions were unanimous.

title: UP govt renames Noida International Airport after PM
content: the renaming will not affect the airport’s IATA code DXN . it will require changes to official name displays, branding and booking-related information . the airport will take the state’s economy, industry, tourism and global connectivity to new heights .

title: 'Our Gen Z deserves better than Emer-Gen Z': Tharoor slams crackdown on protesters
content: Congress MP Shashi Tharoor criticised the heavy security deployment and restrictions in Delhi ahead of the protest . he described the arrangements as “war-like” and questioning the restrictions imposed on citizens seeking to demonstrate peacefully . the move comes in the wake of the Cockroach Janta Party protest against the Election Commission .

title: Who will lead CJP protest? Abhijeet Dipke names Ajinkya Shinde in pre-recorded video
content: Cockroach Janta Party names its organisation in-charge Ajinkya Shinde to lead protest . founder abhijeet Dipke, saurav Das and ashutosh Ranka detained at the airport . the party shared a pre-recorded video of Dipke .

title: Congress to hold 'major stir' on Oct 12 as anti-SIR protests escalate
content: congress general secretary KC Venugopal announces a major protest in Delhi . the party-led opposition inDIA bloc will continue their agitation until the electoral process and system were made free and fair . "PM Modi is behaving like a leader nearing his downfall," he adds .

title: What’s happening at Jantar Mantar? 'Cockroaches' grounded before anti-SIR showdown
content: the 'cockroaches' could not make their way to the protest site . the outfit's 'Jantar Mantar 2.0' demonstration demands the removal of Gyanesh Kumar over the Election Commission's special intensive revision of electoral rolls .

title: CJP protesters seek shelter in gurdwara amid police crackdown in Delhi
content: protesters wearing cockroach-antennae helmets, raising slogans and seeking refuge inside a gurdwara to evade detention marked the proposed demonstration against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar . police detained around 500 protesters attempting to reach Jantar Mantar, where the demonstration was scheduled to begin at 10:30 am .

title: CJP legal head moves court against police for detention during lawyers' stir
content: Ratna Singh, legal affairs head of the Cockroach Janta Party, has moved a court seeking registration of an FIR against police personnel . she has filed it alleging that police personnel prevented her from joining a lawyers’ protest against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over the conduct of the special Intensive Revision .

title: Yogendra Yadav, Prashant Bhushan, Neha Bora detained
content: Activists Yogendra Yadav and Prashant Bhushan detained near INA Market . they headed to the Cockroach Janta Party's planned 'Jantar Mantar 2.0' protest . detentions came amid sweeping crackdown in the national capital .

title: Watch: Kejriwal detained outside residence while attempting march to Jantar Mantar
content: aam aadmi party supremo arvind Kejriwal was detained outside his residence on saturday . he shared a video from inside a bus as slogans of 'Gyanesh Kumar isteefa do' could be heard . the former chief minister had backed the proposed demonstration a day earlier .

title: ‘Nuclear weapons not routine instruments of statecraft’: India’s warning to Pakistan at UN
content: 'India will not bow to nuclear blackmail', says anmol sher Singh Bedi . he said any terrorist attack against the country would invite a fitting response . India said nuclear weapons must not be treated as "routine instruments of statecraft"

title: 'Anarchists have failed, planned to hold Delhi hostage': BJP slams Jantar Mantar stir
content: a flop show of anarchist elements has completely collapsed . the protesters had attempted to hold the country and the national capital hostage . BJP MP Sambit Patra termed the protest a "flop show"

title: ‘Country governed by Parliament, not streets’: BJP slams oppn, CJP over protests
content: BJP MP Ravi Shankar Prasad cites the Supreme Court's handling of challenges to the SIR process . he says opposition parties approached the supreme court to challenge the process of electoral rolls . the BJP spokesperson said the opposition was seeking to build a narrative that India’s democracy was under threat .

title: 'Youth has awakened': Kejriwal shares video following detention during Delhi protests
content: arvind Kejriwal urged supporters across the country to replicate the protest site nationwide . the former chief minister struck a defiant note, declaring, "The youth of the nation has awakened" he then showed other protesters detained alongside him, including aAP leader .

title: 'Settled 8 wars, still no Nobel': Trump fumes over Peace Prize snub
content: he claims he settled eight wars, secured return of hostages and is close to resolving two more conflicts . he also claimed to have won a war in Venezuela, captured its "violent dictator" and prevented Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon .

title: ‘Will be compelled to consider fast or march’: Wangchuk seeks release of detainees
content: sonam Wangchuk described the situation in the national capital as an 'undeclared emergency' in a video message posted on X, he expressed concern over the detention of several political leaders who had planned to participate in protests demanding Kumar’s resignation .

title: 'Rigged when you lose?' 124 ex-officials defend EC & SIR, challenge vote chori claims
content: 124 former IAS, IFS and allied services officers have issued an open letter to citizens defending the Election Commission and the special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls . they argue allegations of vote rigging must be backed by credible evidence . the signatories have challenged claims questioning the credibility of the EC and the need for SIR .

title: Delhi protests: CJP stir against CEC triggers political face-off - top developments
content: the demonstration was called over allegations of voter-list manipulation during the Special Intensive Revision . several protesters, activists, lawyers and opposition leaders were detained as they attempted to reach Jantar Mantar . the detentions also triggered sharp exchanges between the Opposition and the BJP .

title: SIR stir: Former CMs Kejriwal, Mamata, Vijayan among oppn leaders detained
content: former west Bengal chief minister Mamata Banerjee and opposition leader pinarayi Vijayan were detained by Delhi police . they were protesting against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over the special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls . the protests took place on saturday .

title: 'Nalayak neta': BJP accuses Rahul Gandhi of dragging President into 'street fights'
content: the Bharatiya Janata Party branded Rahul Gandhi a 'nalayak neta' the party accused the leader of the opposition of misrepresenting the interaction and drawing the country's highest constitutional office into the political row over alleged “vote chori”

title: 'Arrest us all': Rahul Gandhi dares PM Modi, tells youth to keep protesting
content: police detain more than 3,000 people trying to reach Jantar Mantar for a protest . the opposition leader said he knew them "inside out, like my hand" he furthed youth protesters demanding the resignation of chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar .
